mapper.select: SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , tdm54_company_id AS company_id , tdm54_role_id AS role_id , tdm54_org_id AS org_id , TO_CHAR(tdm54_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date , TO_CHAR(tdm54_due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date , tdm54_plan_action_emp_id AS plan_action_emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_action_emp_id) AS plan_action_emp_name , tdm54_action_nm AS action_name , tdm54_action_plan AS action_plan , tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id AS plan_reg_emp_id , tdm54_status_cd AS status_code , tdm54_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , tdm54_occ_ym AS occ_ym FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm54_chck_insuff ( tdm54_chck_insuff_id, tdm54_company_id, tdm54_role_id, tdm54_org_id, tdm54_reg_date, tdm54_due_date, tdm54_plan_action_emp_id, tdm54_action_nm, tdm54_action_plan, tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id, tdm54_status_cd, tdm54_chck_manl_id, tdm54_occ_ym, tdm54_upd_nm, tdm54_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{chckInsuffId}, #{companyId}, #{roleId}, #{orgId}, CAST(#{req.regDate} AS date), CAST(#{req.dueDate} AS date), #{req.planActionEmpId}, #{req.actionName}, #{req.actionPlan}, #{planRegEmpId}, #{statusCode}, #{req.chckManlId}, #{occYm}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
